answer_1.quote: We explore the feasibility of using LLMs to perform personalized code generation.
answer_1.outputs: personalized code for multiple users according to their individual coding styles

answer_2.quote: With CSS evaluation metric, we can provide a quantitative way to measure the coding style between different codes.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to compare the results of CSS with human results. In particular, we compare MPCODER with L-LDB and Adapter by conducting a user study on PCIDense. We asked 5 users to answer questionnaires of 60 comparative questions, totaling 300 answers.
answer_4.guideline: Users are asked to answer the question: "Which of the two code copies is closer in coding style to the reference code?", and every user is provided with three options (i.e., A is Better, B is Better, Cannot Determine/Both Equally).
